authorization: The J16 Owner instruction authorizes bounded multi-mesh harmonic studies and targeted code fixes. This new contract and attempt namespace follow the J16-001 retry rule after a demonstrated sparse-matrix post-processing error. Publication, release, tagging, and merge remain excluded.

prior_mesh_06_attempt.failure: The exploratory runner called numpy.linalg.norm(matrix, ord=inf) on a SciPy CSR matrix. The post-processing raised ValueError before the first per-frequency raw checkpoint; this is a harness failure, not a mechanical result.
prior_mesh_06_attempt.preservation: The original J16-001 contract, runner record, source commit, and failure status remain unchanged.

execution.retry_policy: One attempt per mesh in this new namespace. Any further attempt requires a separate source/instrumentation change or diagnostic hypothesis, contract, scope registration, and ledger entry.

boundary_conditions: RY=0 on bottom and top edges
RX=0 on left and right edges
model.complex_convention: (K + i*omega*C - omega^2*M) U = F with exp(+i*omega*t)

inputs.mesh_only_variable: MITC4 quadrilaterals per plan edge; every other model and analysis input remains fixed.
inputs.observable: Complex center UZ at the physical point (5,5,0) m; center is a node in each even mesh.

reference.independence: Odd/odd Navier series through index 51; it does not use QF assembled matrices.
reference.theory: Thin Kirchhoff-Love plate compared descriptively with finite-mesh MITC4/Reissner-Mindlin.
reference.comparison_limit: Differences remain sensitive to finite thickness and shell formulation; no mechanical acceptance threshold is defined.

methods_and_indicators.route: At each frequency, solve the same QF-assembled reduced system with raw SciPy spsolve and separately execute the QF direct_frequency route. Preserve the exact QF status; do not promote unguarded vectors.
methods_and_indicators.charge: Archive the assembled resultant, direct translational nodal-force sums, and difference from the analytical flat-area resultant (0,0,-10000) N.
methods_and_indicators.residual: Report relative L2 residual and eta_inf = ||Ax-b||_inf/(||A||_inf||x||_inf+||b||_inf), using sparse-compatible row-sum norms. Keep the production guard at its historical 1e-7.
frequency_indicators: QF K/M first undamped frequency, distinct from the damped response peak.
Dense sampled peak and local quadratic estimate of log amplitude, reported separately.
Amplitude, phase, and complex UZ discrepancy at each common frequency.
Complex discrepancy normalized by the maximum Navier amplitude on the common dense band; phase omitted below 5 percent of that reference peak.
methods_and_indicators.completion_checks: Each mesh has 62 final frequency records and finite raw response vectors; route status is explicit and is never HARNESS_ERROR in a completed test; load-vector self-consistency is checked to 1e-8 N. These are software/output checks, not a mechanical PASS.

resources.estimate: J15's 8x8, 152-frequency run took 42.849 s. The J16 grid is 62 frequencies; 10x10 has more DOFs. The 30-minute and 2-GiB soft limits are conservative estimates, not measurements.

artifacts_to_preserve: Per-frequency JSON and NPZ checkpoints written before QF route execution and finalized afterward.
Per-mesh summary, CSV, setup figure, amplitude/phase plot, peak deformation figure, and artifact manifest.
Separate preflight receipts, attempt ledger, controller/source fingerprints, environment, logs, time and sampled resource observations.
J16-001 failure and all J14/J15 historical results unchanged.
